# (SE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 rewrites it). Diff it against Mednafen: sh7095.inc, ss.c, scu.inc, vdp1.c, vdp2.c, cdb.c.

# A cell is  <w|r><width>@<offset of the access from the register>[^<bus address>]=<rule>[<bits of the value>]<flags>
# flags: * the register's own read/write effect happens, ! it has one and the access does not do it,
#        > the 32-bit bus also reads the register 2 bytes on, x2 it reads this one twice.
# Categories: a accepted, b whole register, c one lane / half / register, d nothing, e address error,
#             f side effect differs, v depends on the value (keyed), - the register's kind says it, ? not decoded.

## Keyed writes

The cells marked KeyedWrite depend on the value: KeyedWrite() says what the key does. Address, width, value (? unknown), what it says:

FFFFFFE0 w4 0x00000003 -> [caution] write to SH2_BCR1 without 0xA55A in the upper half (it is 0x0000): the write does nothing
FFFFFFE0 w4 0xA55A0003 -> [note] SH2_BCR1 keyed write: the low half 0x0003 is taken (0xA55A in the upper half is the key)
FFFFFFE0 w4 ? -> [note] SH2_BCR1 takes a 4-byte write only with 0xA55A in its upper half; any other value does nothing
FFFFFFE4 w4 0x5A5A0003 -> [caution] write to SH2_BCR2 without 0xA55A in the upper half (it is 0x5A5A): the write does nothing
FFFFFFF8 w4 0xA55A00FF -> [note] SH2_RTCOR keyed write: the low half 0x00FF is taken (0xA55A in the upper half is the key)
FFFFFFF0 w4 ? -> [note] SH2_RTCSR takes a 4-byte write only with 0xA55A in its upper half; any other value does nothing
FFFFFFE0 w2 0x0000A55A -> (not a keyed write)
FFFFFE80 w2 0x00005A12 -> [note] keyed watchdog write: requests SH2_WTCNT = 0x12 (taken while SH2_WTCSR's TME is set)
FFFFFE80 w2 0x0000A512 -> [note] keyed watchdog write: SH2_WTCSR = 0x02 (TME is clear: OVF is cleared whatever a read saw, and SH2_WTCNT is reset to 0)
FFFFFE80 w2 0x00001234 -> [caution] watchdog write with key 0x12, which neither SH2_WTCNT (0x5A) nor SH2_WTCSR (0xA5) takes: ignored (it still cancels a pending SH
FFFFFE80 w2 ? -> [note] keyed watchdog write: SH2_WTCNT when the upper byte is 0x5A (taken while SH2_WTCSR's TME is set), SH2_WTCSR when it is 0xA5 (with TME clear, OVF is cleared and SH2_WTCNT reset; with TME set, OVF is cleared only if a read saw it set and SBYCR's SBY is cleared)
FFFFFE82 w2 0x0000A500 -> [note] keyed watchdog write: clears SH2_RSTCSR's WOVF, if a read saw it set
FFFFFE82 w2 0x00005A60 -> [note] keyed watchdog write: SH2_RSTCSR RSTE/RSTS = 0x60
FFFFFE82 w2 0x00001234 -> [caution] SH2_RSTCSR write 0x1234 is neither 0xA500 nor 0x5A with data: ignored (it still cancels a pending WOVF clear)
FFFFFE82 w2 ? -> [note] keyed watchdog write to SH2_RSTCSR: 0xA500 clears WOVF if a read saw it set, 0x5A with data sets RSTE and RSTS
FFFFFE80 w1 0x00000012 -> (not a keyed write)
